Original game VFX texture: small ship explosion: bright core, orange fire, small metal debris. Do NOT paint a checkerboard. Generous empty padding around the object; nothing touches the canvas edge.

END keyframe: effect nearly extinguished, no bright core, only a very faint dispersed trace/smoke and2–4dim tiny embers. Most of canvas completely transparent. Preserve center and same canvas; this is fading END, not a second bright burst. No ships, weapon parts, symbols, labels, interface or opaque background. For joint-break only sparks/chips, not a giant hinge or full firearm. For detach burst use abstract cyan bracket-like flash, no literal letters or UI frame.
